prompt.language: Language: write all texts (zusammenfassung, details, frage, test, vorschlaege) in English. Status values and field names stay exactly as given.
prompt.inspection.task: Task: INSPECTION, question: what would you change in this house? You go through the installation read only. Change nothing.
prompt.inspection.look: Look at: open repairs (ha-read ws repairs/list_issues), entities unavailable for more than 24 hours, automations and scripts with errors in recent runs (ha-read ws trace/list), warnings and errors in the log (ha-read log 500), the configuration check (ha-read check), weak batteries, security gaps (open doors and windows without a notification, disabled alarms), energy (consumers running needlessly, load shifting, PV surplus), comfort (recurring manual steps an automation could take over), cleanup (orphaned entities, unused automations and helpers, duplicates).
prompt.inspection.deliver: Deliver in vorschlaege at most ten suggestions that are really worth it, each with kategorie, nutzen, aufwand and a begruendung with evidence from the installation. What a person has to do on site (change a battery, check a device) gets handarbeit true. Better a few good ones than many. Do not suggest anything WISSEN.md notes as intentional.
prompt.inspection.skip:
These suggestions already exist or were declined, do not suggest them again:
{list}
prompt.inspection.summary: Summarize briefly in details how the house is doing. Status entwurf.
prompt.draft.task: Task: DRAFT. Examine the situation read only and describe exactly what you would change. Change nothing.
prompt.draft.revise: There is already a draft; revise it based on the comments:
prompt.direct.task: Task: IMPLEMENT NOW. A person approved the ticket for implementation without a draft first. Examine the situation, plan and implement. Follow the rules.
prompt.direct.risky: If the change is risky (deleting something, a larger rebuild, safety or protection functions, heating, batteries, inverters) or the goal is unclear: change nothing, status rueckfrage, and describe your plan in details so it can be approved.
prompt.prev_impl_hint: The comments after it describe what to fix.
prompt.impl.task: Task: IMPLEMENTATION of the approved draft. Stick to the draft and the rules. If the situation no longer fits the draft, status rueckfrage.

sug.heading: What would I change?
sug.intro: The caretaker looks at the installation (read only) and suggests what is worth it: errors, security, energy, comfort, cleanup. You decide for each suggestion. Declined ones are not suggested again.
sug.empty_hint: Start "Look around now" or let a regular inspection look (option inspection_day).
runs.heading: Runs
backups.heading: Backups
backups.intro: On every run and before and after every implementation the configuration is saved (without databases, logs, login data and very large files). Roll back from the ticket.
login.heading: Login
login.ok: Claude is logged in. You only need the terminal to renew the login or to look something up.
login.step1: Type `claude` in the terminal below, then `/login`.
login.step2: Choose "Claude account with subscription" and open the link in the browser.
login.step3: Copy the code back into the terminal, then quit with `/exit`.
new.heading: New ticket
new.title: What should happen?
new.title_ph: e.g. only switch the hallway light on dimmed at night
new.text_ph: What exactly, where, why. The more concrete, the better the draft.
new.mode_draft_hint: Claude looks at everything on the next run and makes a proposal. You approve it.
new.mode_now_hint: Starts now, without a draft. For risky things Claude still asks first.
new.mode_collect_hint: Goes on the list, nothing happens yet.
new.hint: Tickets also come from the todo list "Hausmeister", by voice or from automations. An item starting with "now:" or "!" is implemented right away. Without the immediate mode nothing is changed without your approval.
